# Get input from a Spectator

Source: [wiki article 4830](../archive/4830.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4830-n1"></a>

- A spectator host's input can be read through Host Player and Is Button Held.

<a id="wiki-4830-n2"></a>

- Other spectators' input is read only in visual-element fields using Local Player; Not(Entity Exists(Local Player)) is proposed to identify a spectator.

<a id="wiki-4830-n3"></a>

- Spectator controls map unexpectedly: Move Down→Ability1, Move Up→Interact, Move Fast→Secondary Fire, Move Slow→Primary Fire, Lock On→Ability2, Modify FOV→Jump, Disable Camera Blending→Ultimate.
